# Math rendering

KaTeX 0.16.22, unchanged upstream ES module, MIT license (see KaTeX-LICENSE.txt).
Copied from the locally installed KaTeX distribution. No runtime CDN dependency.
Official API: https://katex.org/docs/api.html
Options/security: https://katex.org/docs/options.html

Staff explanations use MathML output with trust disabled, bounded macro expansion,
isolated macros, and escaped fallback text. Modern browser MathML supplies math
layout and accessibility without adding a second web-font dependency.
